customSections.content: The 2026–27 YCSD calendar starts and ends one calendar day earlier than 2025–26. Winter Break and Spring Break also shift one day earlier.

calendarFaqs.q: Are YCSD early release days potential make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official 2026–27 calendar notes that all early release days and student holidays are potential make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in the York County School Division 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: MySchoolDates counts 180 scheduled student days from the district's published calendar. YCSD does not publish a separate 180-day total in the reviewed PDF, so this is a calculated figure.

calendarFaqs.q: Does YCSD have early release days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. YCSD lists early release on January 22, April 2, April 30, and June 9, 2027. The school-hour table on this page shows the official dismissal time for each school group.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the YCSD calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link on this page to open the York County School Division student calendar PDF. MySchoolDates also provides an .ics calendar file for calendar apps.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the YCSD calendar include report card and interim dates?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026–27 YCSD calendar includes quarter starts, interim reports, elementary report cards, and middle and high school report card dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Can YCSD weather closures change the school calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Weather closures, emergency changes, and make-up day decisions can alter the published schedule. Families should check YCSD for the latest updates.
